title: Data migration where the documented command fails and the provided tool is wrong

requirements.text: out/customers.jsonl exists and every line is an object with exactly the five specified keys and types
Exactly the right rows are accepted, in input order
Names are trimmed with inner whitespace collapsed
Both date formats are converted to ISO dates
Balances are converted to exact integer cents
out/rejected.csv lists every rejected row with its line number, the correct reason and the raw line
out/summary.json matches the outputs and its counts reconcile
No row is lost: accepted plus rejected equals the number of data rows
